text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and I ended up having so much fun— 
Ah, the wind! The snack bag...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, the snacks spilled all over the 
floor. I'll go grab a broom and dustpan.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh? This broom...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong with the broom?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The rattling at the tip is totally fixed! 
And there isn't a speck of dust on the 
bristles! It looks brand new!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
W-Wow, you're right! Someone took care of 
it♪ ...Was it Messiah-san again this time?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It has to be! I'm on the beautification 
committee, after all!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Looking closely, even the inside of the 
cleaning supply closet is sparkling 
clean~! Hehe, it feels so good~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I'm honored by your kind words. After 
all, I want everyone to feel comfortable 
while cleaning."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Messiah-san, you were here?!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I didn't mean to eavesdrop, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No, don't apologize! Thank you for always 
keeping things clean, Messiah-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Maintaining cleaning tools is normally the 
General Affairs Committee's 
responsibility, but... we do use them 
during Beautification Committee work as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as expected of you! Come to think of 
it, what kind of work does the 
beautification committee usually do?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The items on this checklist outline the 
duties for the Beautification Committee.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so many...! But if we get a 
checklist, that'll make the work much 
easier to do♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... I made that one myself. Another 
Beautification Committee member wanted 
one, so I consulted with the teacher and 
cleaned up the formatting.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you made this yourself!? THIS!? 
Woooow, amazing!!! No wonder everyone 
wants one!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. If you notice 
anything regarding the campus 
beautification, please contact me anytime. 
I'll take care of it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ho... This is quite something...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-senpai? Um, is there something 
concerning about the flowerbed?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Messiah. No, I just thought the 
flowers were looking so lively.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Remember the fertilizer you spread a while 
back? Looks like it's really showing 
results.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I purchased the fertilizer Air 
Groove-senpai recommended using the 
Beautification Committee's budget and 
spread it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Every time I watered them, I could feel 
the effect too. Air Groove-senpai truly 
understands how flowers feel.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
All I gave you was mere knowledge. You 
were the one who took the proper measures 
and painstakingly cared for them without 
cutting corners.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I haven't had much time to tend to the 
flower beds lately. Having someone like 
you on the beautification committee is a 
real lifesaver.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It is truly an honor. By the way, there's 
something I'd like to consult you on. A 
student was saying something like this the 
other day—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
They bloomed so beautifully! Red, yellow, 
pink, white...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"There aren't any blue flowers, though. 
Ever since Rice-san told me about blue 
roses, I've kind of been looking for one, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, Rice doesn't see them much either. 
It'd be nice if we could see them at the 
Academy someday, though..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Blue flowers, huh. Caring for them gets 
tougher as the varieties increase, but 
Messiah should manage just fine."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll pick out a few good ones. Please 
review them with the beautification 
committee.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I would like to do 
just that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I spotted Air Messiah 
after she had finished planting the 
flowers in the flowerbed.
choice_data_list: Good on you for being so diligent.
Good on you for being so diligent.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...! Fufu, lately I've been getting 
quite a lot of compliments on my 
Beautification Committee work.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's not that I do it to be praised, 
but it truly makes me happy nonetheless.
choice_data_list: I'm glad all your hard work paid off.

This really makes me want to work even 
harder.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes. When all my hard work bears 
fruit, it makes me proud to know my 
methods were right.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I'm trying my hand at growing 
some flowers that are a bit tricky to 
raise. Please look forward to it, 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Air Messiah returned to work, her back 
overflowed with quiet motivation.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. When you start seeing the fruits 
of your labor, your motivation naturally 
goes up.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Just imagining the flowers we're planting 
now successfully in bloom makes my heart 
flutter... I think I'm going to love my 
beautification committee duties even 
more."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Air Messiah returned to work, her back 
somehow looked full of excitement.
